feeds.what: every contest of the election, one row per contest × county × candidate (3,063 rows, 176 contests, 67 counties), tab-delimited with a header row. No statewide total rows: sum CanVotes over counties.
feeds.notes: URL = <YYYYMMDD of election day>_ElecResultsFL.txt on an Azure blob store behind Azure Front Door (x-ms-blob-type: BlockBlob, ETag present, not compressed). The Downloads page links it with a cache-buster '?v=181934787' that is not needed. UTF-8 without BOM, CRLF. Columns: ElectionDate, PartyCode, PartyName, RaceCode, RaceName, CountyCode, CountyName, Juris1num, Juris2num, Precincts, PrecinctsReporting, CanNameLast, CanNameFirst, CanNameMiddle, CanVotes. IMPORTANT: this host's TLS certificate (CN=*.floridados.gov, GoDaddy) expired on 2026-11-09 14:09:06 GMT, the day before this fetch; curl refuses it (SEC_E_CERT_EXPIRED) and so will a Worker's fetch. The files here were fetched with certificate checking turned off (curl -k), so their bytes are unauthenticated. Last-Modified was Fri, 06 Nov 2026 23:10:54 GMT (the site header says '1st Set of Unofficial Returns').

feeds.what: pipe-delimited 'Informational File': the lookup tables (races, candidates, counties, precinct totals per race × county)
feeds.notes: Bracketed records, one per line: [r|FLDOS|seq|race name|General Election|race id] (176), [c|FLDOS|seq|race id|last|first|candidate id] (406), [u|FLDOS|seq|county name|county FIPS] (67), [p|FLDOS|seq|race id|county FIPS|precincts] (1,137). Race ids encode office and district: 120000 = United States Senator, 140010 = Representative in Congress District 1, 900001 = Amendment No. 1. Fetched with -k (expired certificate).

feeds.notes: [V|FLDOS|seq|I|race id|county FIPS|precincts reporting|candidate id|votes], e.g. [V|FLDOS|385939|I|120000|12001|0|89119|34832]. Field meanings are read off the data and the layout PDF's name, not checked line by line against the PDF. Fetched with -k.

discovery: No list endpoint. https://floridaelectionwatch.gov/Downloads always shows the current election's files; the name is predictable from the election date. floridaelectionwatch.gov only shows one election at a time.

bot_blocking: floridaelectionwatch.gov pages: 200 with the plain relay User-Agent, no challenge. flelectionfiles.floridados.gov: no bot blocking either, but the TLS handshake fails for every client that checks certificates because the certificate expired 2026-11-09 14:09:06 GMT (verified with openssl s_client: notAfter=Nov 9 14:09:06 2026 GMT). With checking off, relay UA got 200 on all four files. Browser User-Agent not tried (the failure is TLS, not the UA).
updated_field: None inside the files. Use the HTTP Last-Modified header ('Fri, 06 Nov 2026 23:10:54 GMT', UTC) or the ETag. The site header names the set of returns: '1st Set of Unofficial Returns (pursuant to s. 102.141, F.S.)'.
reporting_field: Per row (race × county): Precincts and PrecinctsReporting, e.g. Alachua 63 / 0 while Baker is 9 / 9 and Bay 30 / 30 — note a county can show 0 reporting while already carrying votes (early and mail ballots). Sum both over a race's counties for the statewide figure; each county repeats on every candidate row, so count it once.

other_statewide: Shall Justice Carlos G. Muñiz be retained in Office?
measures: Exemption of Tangible Personal Property on Agricultural Land From Taxation

choice_format: Name split over three columns with party in its own columns: PartyCode 'REP', PartyName 'Republican Party', CanNameLast 'Moody', CanNameFirst 'Ashley', CanNameMiddle ''. The governor ticket is packed oddly: CanNameLast 'Avila', CanNameFirst 'Donalds', CanNameMiddle '/' (i.e. 'Donalds / Avila'). Measures (RaceCode AMD): CanNameLast 'Yes for Approval' / 'No for Rejection', PartyCode NOP. Judicial retention: CanNameLast 'Yes' / 'No'. In the tab file an amendment's RaceName is only its subject ('Budget Stabilization Fund'; the third has a leading space); the number is only in the Info file's race name ('Amendment No. 1: Budget Stabilization Fund').
district_field: Separate fields: RaceCode gives the office (USS, USR, GOV, ATG, CFO, AGR, STS, STR, SCJ, DCA, CTJ, AMD) and Juris1num the district, zero-padded to 3 ('001'); it is three spaces for statewide races and empty for amendments. Juris2num carries a seat/group number for judges and special districts. The district is also in RaceName ('…, District 1').
